versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- No files were changed between versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.
- Documentation, code, and skill behavior remain the same.

Initial release of baidu-map-rtos-skills.

- Provides integration guidelines and code generation standards for the mapsdk-rtos Baidu Map SDK on RTOS platforms.
- Supports authentication, map component control, overlays (Marker/Polyline), route search, offline maps, navigation, and Canvas adaptation.
- Includes quick reference docs for API usage, adapter interfaces, overlays, search/navigation/offline features, and troubleshooting.
- Clarifies supported header files and responsibilities, targeting app developers integrating Baidu Map SDK.
